_about: Property lists used by scripts/jsonld.py. Each entry is a summary, written from memory, of what a search engine's documentation asks for on one schema.org type. All are unverified: open the source named in the entry and correct the list before trusting a pass. 'required' and 'one_of' produce failures, 'recommended' produces warnings, 'nested' checks objects found at a dotted path, 'also' lists subtypes checked with the same list.

Article.note: Google lists no required properties; author.name appears only under recommended properties, so a missing author name no longer fails

Product.note: Offer requires price (or priceSpecification.price; this check only reads price); priceCurrency is not listed as required. Google recommends aggregateRating, offers and review, not image or description. aggregateRating.ratingValue was not re-read: Google refers to the review snippet page for it

Organization.note: no required properties; name, url and logo are among the recommended ones. Google names OnlineStore, OnlineBusiness and LocalBusiness as subtypes; Corporation is a schema.org subtype not named there

BreadcrumbList.note: ListItem.item is also required except on the last item; name is not needed when item is a Thing with its own name

value.note: As far as remembered, the FAQ result is shown only for a narrow set of well-known government and health sites since 2023; valid markup does not mean the result appears

FAQPage.source: Google Search Central, 'FAQ structured data' and the August 2023 notice about FAQ and HowTo results
FAQPage.note: no current primary source: Google stopped showing FAQ rich results in 2026 and removed the FAQ structured data page (Search Central documentation changelog); the property list stays only as schema.org shape
